CREATE PROC [DW].[HIST_SP_DW_FACTLOANSCREDITLIMIT] AS
BEGIN

WITH 
CustomerAccountLimit
AS(
      SELECT * FROM [BNKM].[CustomerAccountLimit] WHERE LimitTypeId = 'Sanction Limit Amount' AND SourceSystemCode = 'LNS'
)
,
CNT_CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory
AS
(
      SELECT CustomerAccountId, COUNT(RecordTypeId) CNT FROM [BNKM].[CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory] GROUP BY CustomerAccountId
)
, CurrencyConversion
AS(
    SELECT * FROM BNKM.CurrencyConversion WHERE ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND RateId = 'REV'
)
,
Cnt_DimCustomerAccount
AS(

select Accountid,
count(shareindicator) as CNT
 from dw.dimcustomeraccount where shareindicator = 'y'
 group by accountid
)
,Cnt_DimCustomerAccount_bcal
AS(

select Accountid,
count(shareindicator) as CNT
 from dw.dimcustomeraccount where shareindicator = 'y'
 group by accountid
)
,Balance AS (
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT
 CONVERT(VARCHAR,BLLF.[Timestamp],112) AS BusinessDateSK
,DDB.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,DDBK.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,DDA.AccountID AS AccountID
,CASE WHEN BCUS.CoreCustomerId IN (SELECT DISTINCT CoreCustomerId FROM bnkm.LimitLiabilityCustomerMapping)
            AND BLST.StatusCode IN ('NEW', 'RENEW', 'EXTND', 'EXPRD')
            AND BLLF.LimitLiabilityAmount != 0
      THEN CASE WHEN BCA.IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN  BLS.SanctLim * CC.ConversionRate 
                ELSE BLS.SanctLim  END
 ELSE 0 END
  AS CreditLimitAmountFull
,CASE WHEN BCUS.CoreCustomerId IN (SELECT DISTINCT CoreCustomerId FROM bnkm.LimitLiabilityCustomerMapping)
            AND BLST.StatusCode IN ('NEW', 'RENEW', 'EXTND', 'EXPRD')
            AND BLLF.LimitLiabilityAmount != 0
      THEN CASE WHEN BCA.IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN  (BLS.SanctLim * CC.ConversionRate) / DCA.CNT 
                ELSE BLS.SanctLim / DCA.CNT END 
 ELSE 0 END 
  AS CreditLimitAmountProrated
,BLLF.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
FROM [BNKM].[CoreCustomerAccountRelatedLimitLiability] BCRL 
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[LimitLiabilitySanction] BLS ON BLS.LimitId = BCRL.LimitB2KId
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[CustomerAccountParticipation] BCAP ON BCRL.CustomerAccountId = BCAP.CustomerAccountId
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[CustomerAccount] BCA ON BCRL.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId 
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBranch] DDB ON BCA.BranchId = DDB.BranchID AND DDB.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN CurrencyConversion CC ON BCA.IsoCurrencyCode = CC.ConvertFromCurrencyId AND BLS.FinancialInstitutionId = CC.FinancialInstitutionId AND BLS.LimSanctDate = CC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimAccount] DDA ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBank] DDBK ON BLS.FinancialInstitutionId = DDBK.BankID 
LEFT JOIN Cnt_DimCustomerAccount DCA ON DCA.AccountId = BCRL.CustomerAccountId
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[Customer] BCUS ON BCA.CustomerId = BCUS.CustomerId
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[LimitLiabilityStatus] BLST ON BLS.LimitId = BLST.LimitId
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[LimitLiabilityFund] BLLF ON BLS.LimitId = BLLF.LimitId
WHERE BCRL.SOURCESYSTEMCODE = 'LNS'								   


UNION ALL

SELECT DISTINCT
 CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCAL.[Timestamp],112) AS BusinessDateSK
,DDB.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,DDBK.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,DDA.AccountID AS AccountID
,CASE WHEN BCUS.CoreCustomerId NOT IN (SELECT CoreCustomerId FROM bnkm.LimitLiabilityCustomerMapping)
      THEN CASE WHEN  BCAL.IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN BCAL.LimitAmount * CC.ConversionRate
                ELSE BCAL.LimitAmount END
      ELSE 0 END
  AS CreditLimitAmountFull

,CASE WHEN BCUS.CoreCustomerId NOT IN (SELECT CoreCustomerId FROM bnkm.LimitLiabilityCustomerMapping)
      THEN CASE WHEN  BCAL.IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN (BCAL.LimitAmount * CC.ConversionRate) / DCA.CNT
                ELSE BCAL.LimitAmount / DCA.CNT END
  ELSE 0 END 
  AS CreditLimitAmountProrated
,BCAL.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
FROM 
CustomerAccountLimit BCAL 
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[CustomerAccount] BCA ON BCAL.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId AND BCAL.FinancialInstitutionId = BCA.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBranch] DDB ON BCA.BranchId = DDB.BranchID AND DDB.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBank] DDBK ON BCAL.FinancialInstitutionId = DDBK.BankId
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimAccount] DDA ON BCAL.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN BNKM.RepaymentPlanPayment BRRP ON BRRP.FinancialInstitutionId = BCAL.FinancialInstitutionId AND  BRRP.CustomerAccountId = BCAL.CustomerAccountId
LEFT JOIN CurrencyConversion CC ON BCAL.IsoCurrencyCode = CC.ConvertFromCurrencyId AND BRRP.FinancialInstitutionId = BCAL.FinancialInstitutionId and BRRP.DemandDate = CC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[Customer] BCUS ON BCA.CustomerId = BCUS.CustomerId
LEFT JOIN Cnt_DimCustomerAccount_bcal DCA ON DCA.AccountId = BCAL.CustomerAccountId
) A
WHERE CreditLimitAmountFull <> 0 AND CreditLimitAmountProrated <> 0
)
,GetMinMaxDate AS (
SELECT 
	BranchSK,
	BankSK,
	AccountSK,
    AccountId,
	SourceSystemCode, 
    MIN(BusinessDateSK) as min_date, 
    CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()) max_date 
  FROM 
    Balance
WHERE (BranchSK IS NOT NULL
    AND BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL)
    GROUP BY BranchSK ,BankSK ,AccountSK ,AccountID ,SourceSystemCode
)
,FullDateBalance AS (
SELECT 
	b.BranchSK,
    b.BankSK,
    b.AccountSK,
    b.AccountID,
	b.SourceSystemCode,
	CONVERT(VARCHAR,FullDate,112) AS FullDate2,
    a.FullDate, 
    b.min_date, 
    b.max_date 
  FROM 
    dw.dimdate a 
    LEFT JOIN GetMinMaxDate b
	ON a.FullDate >= b.min_date 
    AND a.FullDate <= b.max_date 
  WHERE 
    (BranchSK IS NOT NULL
    AND BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL)
)
,Distinct_Balance AS (
SELECT DISTINCT 
    BranchSK, BankSK, AccountSK, AccountId, BusinessDateSK, CreditLimitAmountFull, CreditLimitAmountProrated, SourceSystemCode, WorkFlowId, TaskRunId, InsertDttm
FROM Balance b
WHERE (BranchSK IS NOT NULL
    AND BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL)
)

INSERT INTO DW.FactLoansCreditLimit
(
     BusinessDateSK
    ,BranchSK
    ,BankSK
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,CreditLimitAmountFull
    ,CreditLimitAmountProrated
    ,SourceSystemCode
    ,WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm
)

SELECT
ISNULL(b.BusinessDateSK, a.FullDate) AS BusinessDateSK
,ISNULL(b.BranchSK,a.BranchSK) AS BranchSK
,ISNULL(b.BankSK,a.BankSK) AS BankSK
,ISNULL(b.AccountSK,a.AccountSK) AS AccountSK
,ISNULL(b.AccountId,a.AccountId) AS AccountId
,MAX(CreditLimitAmountFull) OVER (PARTITION BY a.BranchSK ,a.BankSK ,a.AccountSK ,a.AccountId ,a.SourceSystemCode
ORDER BY a.BranchSK ,a.BankSK ,a.AccountSK ,a.AccountId ,a.SourceSystemCode) AS CreditLimitAmountFull
,MAX(CreditLimitAmountProrated) OVER (PARTITION BY a.BranchSK ,a.BankSK ,a.AccountSK ,a.AccountId ,a.SourceSystemCode
ORDER BY a.BranchSK ,a.BankSK ,a.AccountSK ,a.AccountId ,a.SourceSystemCode) AS CreditLimitAmountProrated
,ISNULL(b.SourceSystemCode,a.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
,ISNULL(b.WorkFlowId,0) AS WorkFlowId
,ISNULL(b.TaskRunId,0) AS TaskRunId
,ISNULL(b.InsertDttm,getdate()) AS InsertDttm
FROM FullDateBalance a
LEFT JOIN Distinct_Balance b
    ON a.BranchSK = b.BranchSK
    AND a.BankSK = b.BankSK
    AND a.AccountSK = b.AccountSK
    AND a.AccountID = b.AccountID
    AND a.fulldate2 = b.BusinessDateSK
    AND a.SourceSystemCode = b.SourceSystemCode

END
GO
